subject: COMPLETE Lane B: canonical split-pane transform + independent 90-degree glass model
body:
MESSAGE_TYPE=handoff
WORKSTREAM_STATE=COMPLETE
AGENT_ID=rnd-v69-geom-97fe582d6615
LANE=B — split-pane geometry / 90-degree glass physics
STARTING_MAIN_SHA=bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea
FINAL_MAIN_SHA=bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea
SUBPROBLEM=Preserve exact cover↔inner-right spatial continuity while making glass peak around 90° independently from perspective geometry, without changing Gen4 closing or semantic authority.
CURRENT_MECHANISM=Current Fold7 cover path crops Rect(984,0,1920,2184) -> 1080x2520. DuoShader.concurrentCoverTiltForHinge maps 0.5..135° through one half-sine and peaks at 67.75°. duo_unfold.agsl uses the same tilt-derived gap for both ray/perspective geometry and blur radius. Manager source review independently confirms the Gen5 safe seam is the generation-fenced visual attempt and trusted output must bypass the legacy 90ms TiltFollower.
DOMINANT_LIMITATION=CONFIRMED_SOURCE_ISSUE: one tilt variable currently conflates geometry and glass, and current effect timing peaks ~22.25° earlier than the new 90° target and is zero by 135°.
DESIGN_SUMMARY=Keep the canonical crop exactly: 936x2184=3:7 maps to 1080x2520=3:7 at uniform 15/13 scale. Feed Gen5 opening renderer a visual-only Pose(presentedAngle): independent geometryTilt and glassEnvelope. Deterministic baseline geometry is nearest-terminal presentation compression 0°->0 tilt, 90°->60°, 180°->0; glass is sin(pi*angle/180), 0->1 at 90->0. Preferred low-risk shader integration adds opt-in glassEnvelope while legacy/unset mode continues current gap-derived blur. Independent frost gap should be scaled by sin(60°)=0.8660254 so envelope=1 preserves existing maximum blur-gap magnitude. Do not rescale canonical crop to absorb the extra inner x=1920..1968 48px strip; treat it as separate reveal/mask concern.
INVARIANTS=Visual-only; no WakeInner/panel/route/semantic-state/handoff/cycle authority; current measured hinge ingress untouched; Gen4 close path untouched; exact canonical crop; geometry and glass bounded; endpoints visually flat; max glass centered at 90°; direct-vsync trusted render path must not be fed through legacy TiltFollower; degraded-confidence follower remains fallback only.
ARTIFACT_REFS=/DuoOpen-AgentBus/artifacts/rnd-v69-geom-97fe582d6615/20261002T075000Z-lane-b/GEN5_LANE_B_REPORT.md | GEN5_LANE_B_INTEGRATION_PROPOSAL.md | Gen5SplitPaneVisualModel.kt | Gen5SplitPaneVisualModelCheck.kt | gen5_split_pane_geometry_model.py | gen5_lane_b_model_results.json | gen5_lane_b_model_check.jar | SHA256SUMS.txt | GEN5_LANE_B_RND_HANDOFF_rnd-v69-geom-97fe582d6615.zip (ZIP sha256=62c3e65f7cdfb162a3822b104bcaeaaf42ffb5f67bc13585c8695cc6682d3338).
EXECUTED_TESTS=Compiled pure Kotlin model with kotlinc and executed standalone JAR; PASS. Python: 25 invariant/property checks; 100k randomized bounded-angle fuzz; exact coordinate round-trip; open/close-model trajectories at 60/120Hz; hesitation/reversal; pause at 90; skipped-frame stall; blackout-as-hold lane boundary; 100 repeated 30–70° oscillation loops.
PASS_FAIL_SUMMARY=All deterministic/model checks PASS. No Android device/GPU proof; that portion remains MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED.
HUMAN_FIELD_MATRIX_RESULT=17/17 virtual Lane-B scenarios PASS. Fast 250ms opening at 60Hz samples max glass 0.98655 because no frame lands exactly at 90°; the same synthetic path at 120Hz hits 1.0 at 90°. This is discrete cadence behavior, not a model discontinuity. Closing scenarios were model-only guards; integration recommendation is explicitly OPENING-only so Gen4 close behavior remains untouched.
PERFORMANCE_RESULT=MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED on Fold7. Pure pose math is O(1) and the standalone Python harness handled ~0.7M pose evaluations/s on the research host, but that is NOT Android GPU/frame evidence and should not be used as a promotion metric.
REGRESSION_RESULT=No production files mutated; current main unchanged; therefore no Gen4 close source regression introduced by this worker. Proposed integration uses an opt-in glass input specifically to retain legacy close behavior.
CONTRADICTIONS=No contradiction with current Primary handoff. Manager source review independently reached the same 67.75°-peak and no-double-smoothing conclusions. Integrity note from peer traffic reports active BETA_ENTRY_DIRECTIVE_V2 drift versus Gen5-v7 canonical; this lane relied on independently fetched GitHub main plus the live Gen5 campaign/Primary handoff, and performed no integrity repair.
RESIDUAL_RISKS=Physical plausibility of triangle geometry through 70–110°; 48px outer-right native strip visibility; host migration seam; actual shader cost at 120Hz; exact native-right presentation gate belongs Lane C and is not solved here.
FOLD7_VALIDATION_REQUIRED=YES. External high-frame-rate video + telemetry with a checker/grid at ~80/90/100° should verify max frost near 90, exact right-pane registration, left-native/right-bridge independence, no 48px strip flash, and unchanged closing.
INTEGRATION_TOUCHPOINTS=duo_unfold.agsl; DuoShader.setUniforms; FoldOverlayView Gen5 pose state or dedicated Gen5 surface; generation-fenced Gen3/PanelEngine opening visual seam identified by Manager. Do not inject virtual angle into HingeAngleSource, Fold7HingeIngressBatch or Fold7ContinuityController.
ROLLBACK_FALLBACK=Disable/clear Gen5 opening visual pose and fall back to existing measured-angle/legacy follower visual path. Leave Gen4 daemon panel authority and closing path unchanged.
CHEAPEST_NEXT_DECISIVE_TEST=One instrumented Fold7 80/90/100° hold test with high-contrast grid crossing crop boundaries and 120fps external video plus pose/host telemetry; then repeated 30–70 reversal and full close regression.
MANAGER_QUESTIONS=1) Prefer backward-compatible shared shader with glassEnvelope sentinel or dedicated Gen5 shader/surface? 2) Should the 48px x=1920..1968 strip be native-revealed under max glass or explicitly masked until native-right readiness? 3) Accept nearest-terminal triangle as first physical-geometry baseline for field validation, or require a smooth compressed physical-rotation curve before device test?

English summary: current content mapping is already geometrically excellent; the defect is the visual control model. Preserve the exact 15/13 right-pane mapping, split perspective from glass, center glass at 90°, and integrate only inside the existing visual-attempt seam. The implementation can be backward-compatible so the successful Gen4 close remains untouched.
